strict_note: Current ROM B84 AW1 CO power title proof for all 11 target addresses. Each case writes only the live RAM CO-id byte 0x0201ADBD before the same DOWN DOWN A activation route; ROM bytes, pointer table, and renderer are unchanged. This proves target/source reads and visible title rendering for every B84 slot, but it is not a full natural-route playthrough for every CO.

ram_field.derivation: 0x08B3C254 loads 0x08D845A4 -> 0x0201AD38, uses object player index 1, then reads [record+0x1D] before 0x08B1C194 maps it to the B84 pointer-table slot.
